prompt:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: Fishbound Discord fishing rod showcase card background, portrait 1024 by 1536.
Primary request: Create one finished empty card background for displaying an existing fishing rod sprite, matching the supplied SALVAGE card's chunky retro pixel art and worn riveted wood/metal frame.
Input images: Image 1 (assets/item-cards/salvage.png) is the style and proportions reference, not a foreground object to insert.
Scene/backdrop: A cozy angler's gear display: deep teal and dark blue velvet-like pixel texture behind the rod, soft shaft of light, subtle tiny corner fishing-lodge details. Four-sided weathered timber and bronze rivet frame.
Style/medium: Crisp readable pixel art, warm camp wood and bronze against deep teal, no photorealism.
Composition/framing: One modest weathered bronze/wood nameplate near the top reading "FISHING ROD". Keep the central area from 15% to 85% width and 26% to 84% height unobstructed dark teal, ready for a large diagonal fishing rod sprite. Keep lower-center empty too. No inset stats panel or textbox.
Text (verbatim): "FISHING ROD"
Constraints: One portrait card only. No fishing rod, fish, person, hook, foreground gear, logo, rank letters, stats, quality label, numbers, watermark, or additional text. The central display must stay empty. Preserve the supplied card family's pixel-art frame and exact portrait proportions.
composition: Original rod sprites are alpha-cropped and fitted proportionally into the centered 70 percent width by 58 percent height display box, starting at 26 percent height. Quality-colored corner accents and Discord embed metadata are applied at runtime. Live PNG attachments are 512 by 768 and reuse the bounded artwork cache.
